description: Creates a fresh, free webhook.site test address that needs no account, to be used as a webhook's mirror address, so the host can watch deliveries land without giving anyone access to their real CRM or email provider. Side effect: it creates a new address at that third-party test service and nothing on the connected site changes; each call creates a NEW address, an earlier one stays valid and is not reused. Use it when the host wants to see a webhook work before pointing it at a real system, then save that address with wi_save_webhook and send a test with wi_test_webhook.
